name: Acadiana Plastics Molding
old_description: Acadiana Plastics Molding thrives on innovation and unparalleled customer satisfaction.
about:
Acadiana Plastics Molding operates from New Iberia, Louisiana, where it was founded in 1989 by Kent Byron. The company remains locally owned and operated, with Byron serving as president and chief executive officer. What began as a three-person venture aimed at filling a regional gap—Louisiana food producers previously had to source injection-molded closures from out of state—has grown into a nearly 100-employee operation.

The 22-acre facility houses injection molding presses ranging from 60 to 500 tons, capable of producing parts from 0.05 grams to over 1,000 grams. Annual output exceeds 500 million closures in sizes from 10 mm to 48 mm, including continuous-thread and tamper-evident styles with custom lining options. The product line also covers 19 standard PET bottle styles and the patented STAT® Vial, a unit-dose heat-seal package for the respiratory market, supported by an in-house vial printing process. Engineering and design consulting are offered alongside molding.

Primary markets include the pepper sauce and condiment sector, where the company says it dominates closure sales, as well as respiratory pharmaceutical packaging and craft beverage brands seeking custom containers. The original customer base was Louisiana food companies, but the reach has expanded nationally.

Byron started the business after recognizing that no Southern Louisiana shop specialized in injection-molded plastic closures, forcing local food manufacturers to look elsewhere. The company emphasizes a partnership-oriented service model rather than a purely transactional one, a philosophy it traces back to its founding vision.

name: Accellence Home Medical
old_description: Accellence Home Medical is a locally owned Durable Medical Equipment company serving the Reno, Sparks, Carson and surrounding areas, since 1997.
about:
Accellence Home Medical has operated as a locally owned durable medical equipment provider in Reno, Nevada since 1997. The company serves communities across northern Nevada and the eastern Sierra, including Sparks, Carson City, Fernley, Fallon, Minden, Gardnerville, Dayton, Virginia City, Silver Springs, Yerington, Wellington, Smith Valley, and California locations such as Loyalton, Portola, Graegle, Clio, Beckwourth, Truckee, and the Lake Tahoe area.

The business supplies and services a range of home medical equipment, including oxygen systems, power wheelchairs, CPAP and BiPAP devices, nebulizers, manual wheelchairs, hospital beds, bedside commodes, shower chairs, and walkers. It functions as a distributor and service provider rather than a manufacturer, delivering equipment to patients in residential and care settings.

Its customer base consists primarily of individuals requiring home healthcare equipment across the listed service areas, as well as healthcare providers and facilities in the region. The company focuses on the durable medical equipment segment of the healthcare industry.

The company emphasizes its local ownership and long-standing presence in the region since 1997.

name: Accumold
old_description: Bring your ideal micro part design and let Accumold be your key to success.
about:
Accumold operates from a 15-acre campus in Ankeny, Iowa, just north of Des Moines. The company traces its roots to a rented garage where its founders recognized a growing demand for micro injection molded components that exceeded the capabilities of conventional molding systems. While the exact founding year is not publicly stated, the firm notes four decades of exclusive focus on micro molding and tooling.

Accumold provides vertically integrated micro manufacturing, encompassing tooling, injection molding, micro 3D printing, packaging, and metrology under one roof. Its core process is high-precision thermoplastic injection molding for parts with micron-level tolerances, complemented by additive manufacturing for rapid prototyping. The campus houses advanced metrology including a Zygo NewView 8300 optical profiler, OGP multi-sensor systems, and Keyence vision inspection, enabling measurement of features down to tenths of a micron. The company also offers design for micro molding (DfMM), process validation, and Gage R&R studies.

The company serves medical device OEMs producing components for endoscopes, diagnostics, and implantable sensors; micro-electronics manufacturers needing connectors and lead frames; polymer optics firms requiring micro-lenses and fiber arrays; automotive electronics suppliers pursuing high-volume micro-systems; and emerging technology developers in wearables and smart devices. Materials range from medical-grade biocompatible resins (ISO 10993) to engineering thermoplastics such as ABS, PVC, PMMA, and nylon equivalents.

Accumold differentiates itself by embedding metrology into every production stage, asserting that "if you cannot measure it, you cannot make it." Its vertically integrated model ensures that tooling, molding, and inspection are co-located, allowing rapid iteration and consistent quality at micro scale. The firm emphasizes continuous investment in measurement technology and automation to maintain precision as parts shrink further.

name: Accusemble Electronics Inc
old_description: Accusemble Electronics specializes in precision prototype development and New Product Introduction (NPI).
about:
Accusemble Electronics Inc. was founded in 1979 and operates from North Billerica, Massachusetts. The company is led by President Deborah Bayley and has built its reputation on the principles of quality, value, and service.

The company provides custom circuit board assembly and contract manufacturing services ranging from engineering prototypes and new product introduction (NPI) through low-, medium-, and high-volume production runs. Its capabilities include surface-mount technology (SMT) assembly using five Yamaha pick-and-place systems, automated optical and X-ray inspection, drag soldering and hybrid heating rework stations, conformal coating with urethane and acrylic materials, and full supply-chain procurement. The facility also offers extensive rework and repair services for electronic assemblies.

Accusemble serves both defense and commercial markets. In the defense sector it delivers mission-critical circuit board assemblies built to rigorous standards. Commercial customers span consumer electronics and industrial applications, where the company supplies custom, high-quality circuit board solutions.

The business was started to provide high-quality contract manufacturing with a focus on continual improvement of manufacturing methods. President Deborah Bayley states that the company maintains a constant desire to offer products and services of superior quality and workmanship, supported by an in-house IPC-A-610-certified trainer and advanced inspection technology.

name: Accutech Fabrication Inc
old_description: Our Brakes offer versatile bending capabilities for sheet metal fabrication.
about:
Accutech Fabrication Inc operates from Lynchburg, Virginia. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed in the available sources. It presents itself as a sheet metal fabrication and machining shop serving a range of industrial customers.

The shop provides sheet metal fabrication and CNC machining services. Its capabilities include press brake bending, laser cutting, multi-axis milling, powder coating, rolling, sandblasting, MIG and TIG welding, and band saw cutting. Equipment listed includes a Proto Trak3 2-axis CNC mill with 32 inches of travel and a Track DPM RX5 CNC bed mill with a 30 by 15 inch table and 40 inches of travel. Part size capacity ranges up to 144 by 144 inches for brake work, 59 by 119 inches for laser cutting, and 90 by 90 by 240 inches for machining, with a 60-inch width capacity for unlimited length on certain operations. The company states it handles projects from prototyping through production runs.

The company serves industrial manufacturing, automotive, and electronics sectors. Its brake forming services are described as suitable for creating precise and complex parts across many industries.

Accutech emphasizes a commitment to quality and highlights its versatile bending capabilities for sheet metal fabrication as a core offering. The company also notes that its powder coating process uses an electrostatic charge to create smooth, even finishes with resistance to chipping, scratching, and fading.

name: Acutech Metalworks
old_description: Acutech Metalworks is your complete one-stop fabrication shop in the Flathead Valley
about:
Acutech Metalworks operates from Columbia Falls, Montana, in the Flathead Valley. The company brings over 40 years of industry experience to custom metal fabrication, though a specific founding year is not publicly stated. Ownership details and founder names are not disclosed.

The shop provides a full range of fabrication services under one roof. Capabilities include waterjet, laser, and plasma cutting on tables described as the largest in the valley; CNC machining and programming; AutoCAD design and prototyping; MIG, TIG, and stick welding; blacksmithing; and ornamental wrought iron work such as railings and gates. The facility also handles structural steel fabrication and installation, architectural metalwork, and PowerLift hydraulic door systems. The company emphasizes quick turnaround on high-quality parts.

Acutech serves the architectural metals market nationwide and acts as a supply chain partner for diverse industries. Concrete projects include a partnership with a national door brand and collaboration with a California-based security company to develop a palm-recognition security system. The company has also expanded its architectural fabrication services through specialized employee training.

The firm cites its commitment to quality craftsmanship, innovation, and customer service as the foundation of its reputation, which was recognized by a 2026 Best of the Flathead and Best of Montana award for metal fabrication.

name: Advanced Circuitry International
old_description: At Advanced Circuitry International we’ve been manufacturing a wide array of Antenna PCB’s since 2011.
about:
Advanced Circuitry International was founded in 1992 in Duluth, Georgia, as an independently owned manufacturer of high-reliability RF/microwave and antenna printed circuit boards. The company began with a focus on aerospace, defense, telecommunications, and medical device markets, building expertise in exotic substrates such as Teflon and ceramics.

Today the company operates a 70,000-square-foot facility and is expanding into an additional 50,000 square feet. Its capabilities span RF/microwave PCBs, antenna PCBs, large-format boards up to 24 by 102 inches, multilayer constructions, rapid prototyping, and full assembly of RF/microwave and antenna sub-systems. The shop also provides design-for-manufacturability assistance, impedance modeling, in-process and final inspection testing, and a logistics program that stocks laminate materials and finished goods for qualified customers.

Advanced Circuitry serves a global base of OEMs and EMS providers across land, sea, air, and space applications. Specific markets include 5G infrastructure, base stations, GPS, microwave communications, small cells, automotive electronics, and marine systems. The company's customer list includes notable original equipment manufacturers and electronics manufacturing services firms worldwide.

It emphasizes control of passive intermodulation (PIM) for low-PIM applications, rapid turnaround supported by a large inventory of RF materials, and the ability to produce exceptionally large antenna structures on a wide range of high-frequency laminates.

name: Advanced Medical Device Technologies, Inc.
old_description: Safe, Effective, and Cost-Efficient Medical Devices for Medical, Clinical, Research, Commercial, and Industrial Applications
about:
Advanced Medical Device Technologies, Inc. is based in Las Vegas, Nevada.

The company develops patented medical device platforms spanning fluid warming, respiratory support, and air disinfection. Its fluid warming system heats intravenous fluids and blood products to within a tenth of a degree using less than 100 watts on 110 volts, with zero cross‑contamination risk. The respiratory platform integrates a ventilator, CPAP/BiPAP, compressor, gas mixer, and full lung‑compliance monitoring in a single compact unit. A third line attaches to exhalation paths and raises air temperature to 800 °C to eradicate viruses. All designs emphasize manufacturability for scalable production.

Target markets include medical, clinical, research, commercial, and industrial sectors, with the company noting that its intellectual property can extend into other large vertical markets. Customers range from hospitals and research labs to commercial and industrial operators seeking compact, energy‑efficient devices.

Advanced Medical Device Technologies was founded to provide technologies that enhance patient outcomes by improving safety, reducing costs, and increasing reliability. The firm states that its disruptive, patent‑protected designs are engineered for high quality and ease of manufacturing, positioning its patent portfolio as a licensable platform for sellable products.
